scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @henriquebastosnet/orbital && npm run build --workspace @henriquebastosnet/pi-orbital
scripts.test:local: npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:install: npm run build && node --import tsx tests/integration/pi-install.ts
scripts.test:hosted: npm run build && node --import tsx tests/integration/pi-flow.ts
scripts.test:preparation: npm run build && node --import tsx tests/integration/preparation-hosted.ts
scripts.test:lifetime: npm run build && node --import tsx tests/integration/lifetime.ts
